notes: Energy is a PHYSICAL measurement, not a model output, so bitwise determinism is NOT required to make an energy reading valid. The 5 physical measurement repeats per point capture timing/thermal noise; the init seed only fixes which random weights and inputs are drawn.

The full size+precision grid uses a single init seed (42). Multiple init seeds are used only in the representativeness check, where weight/input variation is the actual object of study (bounding energy drift vs DDEV).

Deterministic mode (torch.use_deterministic_algorithms(True), CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8) is enabled ONLY for the output-correctness portion of the real-weight spot checks, not for the energy sweep, since some fast cuBLAS/cuDNN kernels are non-deterministic and forcing determinism would change the kernels (and thus the energy) being measured.
Random-init weight tensors and synthetic input token ids are drawn under master_seed 42 unless a representativeness seed is specified.
